A WORD FROM OUR PASTOR

Welcome to Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville

At Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville, you will never be “lost in the crowd.”

Thank you for visiting Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville online.

Founded by Pastor (Dr.) W. F. Kumuyi, Deeper Life Bible Church Worldwide is a Bible-believing church whose aim in all things is “achieving heaven’s goal.”

Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville is one of the branches in the Southwest Region, under the leadership of our Regional Overseer, Pastor Thompson Aderemi.

We trust that this virtual visit will inspire you to worship with us in person very soon. While you are here, we encourage you to take time to learn more about us by exploring What We Believe and reading about our impact in the community.

Our prayer and purpose are to bring people to Christ and help them grow in Him. Whether you are seeking a church home or have questions about Jesus Christ, we are here to serve you in any way we can. At Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville, you will never be “lost in the crowd.” We are a church family where the pastor and members know and care for one another personally.

If you have questions not answered on this site or would like additional information, please visit our Contact page to reach us.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Meet our leadership
What we believe

YOUR FIRST VISIT

What to expect

Visiting a church for the first time can feel like a big step. Here’s what a Sunday looks like, so you can walk in already feeling at home.

About 2½ hours
Singing, prayer, Bible study and teaching
Parking and arrival

Free parking is available in the lot around the plaza where the church meets. Look for the large Deeper Life Lewisville sign in front of the building; it shows you’re in the right place.

Kids & families

Children of every age are welcome in worship. During the Sunday service, we also offer a safe, staffed Children’s Church for infants through 6th grade.

What to wear

Come as you are. You'll see everything from Sunday best to comfortable clothes. We care far more about you being here than what you're wearing.

Our gathering

Our Sunday service lasts about two and a half hours and blends singing, prayer, Bible study (Search The Scriptures), and teaching. Before the service, we pray together online at 9:00 AM ([Zoom link to come]), and you’re welcome to join us.

TESTIMONY

FROM DEPORTATION TO DELIVERANCE: JESUS MIRACULOUSLY RESCUES AND TURNS MISTAKE INTO A MERCY-FILLED MIRACLE
Share your testimony

Jesus is indeed alive! I was on the verge of deportation after my US visa was denied — but our fathers in the Lord prayed for supernatural favor, and Jesus showed up. I was readmitted to the United States the very next day, and multiple souls came to know the Lord along the way. All glory to Jesus for turning my mistake into a miracle of mercy.

B
Bro K

Jude 1:3, KJV
